_readme: Task Data Requirements Registry. Key = `${cadence}-${phaseIndex}`, matching the phase order in CADENCES inside tsm-rcm-os.html. Each entry names the specific fields an EU needs to gather from the owning module for that phase, why the field matters, and its type. This is what makes the AI Assistant's guidance specific instead of generic — see routes/rcm-requirements.js.

requiredFields.why: Confirms the overnight batch was actually pulled before the 9 AM cutoff, not just assumed complete.

requiredFields.field: AP invoices verified as queued for payment
requiredFields.why: Task 2 requires verifying queued invoices; without a count there's no evidence the check happened.
Task 4 is explicitly to flag gaps — this is the record of what was found, even if the answer is "none".
Confirms task 1 (post daily journal entries) actually happened today.
Task 3 requires flagging variance over 5% — names the specific departments, not just a yes/no.
Task 4's output — how many items were tagged today.
The dashboard review in task 1 isn't evidenced without a current flag count.
Task 2's concrete output for the day.
Task 4 requires escalation — names which flags, not just that escalation occurred.

requiredFields.field: Departments over the >5% variance threshold this week
requiredFields.why: Task 2's rollup result — the whole point of the weekly sweep.

requiredFields.field: Unapplied cash or negative balances found
requiredFields.why: Task 3's specific finding, needed before the branch-lead summary in task 4 can be written.
Task 1's spot-check result — SoD gaps must be named, not just counted, to be actionable.

requiredFields.field: Flags from the week still unresolved
requiredFields.why: Task 2 requires confirming all flagged items were resolved — this is the count that didn't get there.
Task 1's core figure — the liability position for the week.

requiredFields.field: Duplicate or disputed vendor charges found
requiredFields.why: Task 3's specific finding, needed to catch AP leakage before it compounds.
Task 1's status count — how many exceptions are still open.
Task 4 requires flagging exceptions with unresolved exposure — the dollar figure ties logistics back to the books.
Task 4's explicit output — names which verticals, so leadership isn't left guessing.
Task 4 requires documenting the levers — this is that documentation, not just that modeling ran.

requiredFields.field: Vendor disputes still unresolved before close
requiredFields.why: Task 4 requires resolving remaining disputes before books close — this tracks what's still open.
Task 1's deliverable — a direct yes/no evidence point for the audit package.
Task 3 requires this confirmation before sign-off.
Task 4's closing confirmation for the month-end cycle.
